review.item_premise: Only public committed data, numeric display declarations, typed narrative references and rendered documentation are consumed and returned. Dataset forms use the registry arithmetic at projection; rendering selects forms and resolves explicit references without arithmetic or free-text numeric parsing. No secret carrier or new exposure boundary is admitted. Optional paper keys and tags are public published-result identifiers retained in the projection; validation requires both fields together. External build data is compared by the separate correspondence check and is not an observation payload or registry copy.
